fail_to_pass: slashes at either end and doubled slashes do not matter
the root route matches / and the empty string
a failed static branch falls back to a parameter
a failed parameter branch falls back to a wildcard
precedence is decided segment by segment from the left
a wildcard needs at least one segment and captures the rest joined by a slash
parameters are percent-decoded and so are static comparisons
malformed percent-encoding anywhere in the path gives no match
several parameters are captured under their own names
matching is case sensitive and handlers can be any value
a route with the same shape is a duplicate, whatever its parameter names
routes that differ only after a shared parameter are not duplicates and keep their own names
a parameter named like an object property is an ordinary parameter
a path segment that looks like an object property does not match by accident
match with something that is not a string finds nothing
a static segment wins over a parameter
